dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I think I'll read a little before the next battle begins.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Please refrain from recommending something like a newspaper. I recognize that short-form articles may be a fitting choice considering the limited amount of time at our disposal...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: But they're simply not to my taste.
